desktop_shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
desktop_shortcuts.description: Open Synara screens from anywhere. These keys stop working in other apps while Synara runs; clear a field to turn that shortcut off.

accent_color.title: Accent color
accent_color.description: Buttons, links and selected items. Theme default until you pick a color.

inline_gif_links.title: Play GIF links inline
inline_gif_links.description: Show Klipy and GIPHY links as GIFs. Your device loads them from the provider, which can see your IP address.

x_embeds.title: Show X posts
x_embeds.description: Show the post and play its video for x.com links. Your device contacts X, which can see your IP address.

link_previews.title: Link previews
link_previews.description: When a message has a link, Synara fetches the page from this device to show a preview. The site can see your IP address.

base_color.title: Base color
base_color.description: Tints the rail, room list and chat. Lightness is mapped to the stacked greys, not used as a fill.

gif.disabled_by_config: GIF search is disabled by this client configuration.

onboarding.title: Enable GIFs?
onboarding.description: GIF search downloads your selected GIF privately, uploads it to Matrix media, then sends an mxc:// attachment.
onboarding.description_link: GIF search contacts the GIF provider from this device, so it can see your IP address. GIFs you send are links that Synara plays inline.

gif.command_description: Search for a GIF to send. Example: /gif high five
